# santati_event_definitions (Data Source)

The team's event catalog: every action an event may name. The control plane pages the list; the provider reads every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "santati_event_definitions" "all" {}

output "active_actions" {
  value = [for def in data.santati_event_definitions.all.event_definitions : def.action if def.is_active]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `event_definitions` (Attributes List) The event definitions, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event_definitions))

<a id="nestedatt--event_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `event_definitions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action name, for example `invoice.voided`.
- `allowed_target_types` (List of String) The target types an event with this action may name; empty means any target type.
- `created_at` (String) When the action was first defined.
- `description` (String) What the action means, for the people reading the catalog.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the action is in force. When a team has any definitions, an action whose definition is not active is treated as undefined.
- `updated_at` (String) When the definition was last changed.
